chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from al-Washa, from Aban, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Bedouins said: We believe. Say: You do not believe, but say: We are Muslims. So whoever claims that they have believed, he has lied, and whoever claims that they have not become Muslims, he has lied'.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Islam and Iman according to the statement of the Bedouins in Surah Al-Hujurat?
ai.summary: This hadith elucidates the nuanced distinction between 'Islam' (external submission) and 'Iman' (internal faith) by analyzing the Quranic verse 49:14, where the Prophet (peace be upon him) corrected the Bedouins' claim of belief. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted to show that while their faith was not yet complete or pure, their outward declaration of Islam preserved their status as Muslims, preventing the accusation of hypocrisy or disbelief. The Imam emphasizes that it is erroneous to assert they had attained full, sincere faith, just as it is false to deny their entry into the fold of Islam through their profession.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Al Washa, from Aban, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I heard himasws saying: ‘[49:14] The Bedouins say: We believe. Say: You do not believe but say, We are Muslims.
So the ones who claim that they have believed, so they have lied, and the ones who claim that they have not become Muslims, so they have lied’.
en.sarwar: 5. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla ibn Muhammad and a number of our people from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all of them from al- Washsha’ from Aban from abu Basir who has said the following: “I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s.) saying, ‘The Arabs have said, “We have established belief.” Say, “You have not established belief but say, ‘We have accepted Islam.’ Belief has not yet entered your hearts.” [49:14]
Whoever thinks that they (Arabs) had belief, his thoughts are false and whoever thinks that they had not accepted Islam he has lied.’”
